text: Hello, it's Tomasz Nowak at Quarry Road. I've got the bill for $1,080 and I'm not disputing it, but I can't pay it all at once on Saturday — it would clean us out. Could we arrange to pay it off in instalments, please? I'm sorry to ask. I can do something regular each week.
reply:
Dear Mr Nowak,

Thank you for your letter of Monday 9 March, and for letting us know straight away. We're glad to help.

We can set up a payment plan for the $1,080 due this Saturday. It will be split into equal weekly instalments, and the regular bill of $210 a week will continue as normal alongside it. The plan can run for between 2 and 12 weeks. Please reply to confirm the number of weeks you'd like, and we'll send you the exact weekly amount and first payment date.

If your circumstances change during the plan, please contact us as soon as possible so we can talk through the options.

Kind regards,
Northgrid Energy Customer Desk

text: Dear Northgrid, thank you for your reply and for being willing to help. I'd like to set up the payment plan over 12 weeks please — the longest option — as money is very tight at the moment. Could you let me know the exact weekly amount and when the first payment would be due. Thank you again, T. Nowak
reply:
Dear Mr Nowak,

Thank you for your letter of Wednesday 11 March. I'm glad to confirm a payment plan for the $1,080 due this Saturday.

The plan is 12 equal weekly instalments of $90. Your regular bill of $210 a week is separate and continues as normal, so please pay that alongside these instalments.

Your first $90 instalment will be due this Saturday, with the remaining 11 instalments due on each following Saturday. Your account is currently showing $0 overdue, so there are no arrears to add to the plan.

If you have any questions, or if your circumstances change, please contact us and we will be glad to look at what options are available.

Kind regards,
Northgrid Energy Customer Desk
